_case: The confidential relying party flipped to public. Its whole security model rests on a server-held secret; a public one keeps the shape and discards the model.

client.name: Dotmac Workspace
client.description: Confidential server-side relying party for workspace.dotmac.io. Its security model rests on a server-held secret, an HttpOnly cookie and a server-side single-use state store, which is exactly why ADR-0069 §4 refuses to ship this client class to a device. The secret itself lives ONLY in OpenBao; see docs/SECRETS.md.
